name: Gas Station Zoning
description: Restrictions on new gas stations through special use approval and zoning changes.
summary: The City Council advanced a series of citywide restrictions on new gas stations. SO2025-0018183, introduced 2025-06-18 to modify Section 17-3-0207 by removing permit requirements for gas stations in B3, C1, and C2 districts, passed 48-1 on 2026-02-18. A successor measure, SO2026-0024923 (introduced 2026-04-15), prohibiting permits for gas stations in B3, C1, and C2 districts and barring new stations within 1,000 feet of an existing station or on the same block face as RS1/RS2/RS3 lots, was amended by substitute in committee on 2026-05-19 [1]; the substitute allows such locations only via a Type 1 map amendment, giving local communities an option to approve them [1]. It passed the City Council 50-0 on 2026-05-20. O2026-0025429, introduced 2026-05-20 to require special use approval for all new gas stations and for additions that would add fueling capacity, was on the Committee on Zoning agenda 2026-07-14 and passed 49-0 on 2026-07-15. Committee discussion on 2026-02-17 addressed grandfathering of existing stations on ownership change, six-month dormancy rules, and the requirement that new stations locate in C3 districts and obtain special use approval [3][6]. Still open: implementation details and any future corridor-specific or ward-level expansions of similar restrictions were discussed as possible blueprints for other wards [5].
one_line: Council passed gas station zoning bans (48-1, 50-0, 49-0); special use approval required; ward-level expansions remain open.
